title: Add scrolling to Vault sidebar and NFT preview page

requirements.summary: Add vertical scrolling to the Vault sidebar so that all sidebar content (layers, filters, controls) is accessible when it overflows the viewport height
acceptanceCriteria: The Vault sidebar scrolls vertically when its content exceeds the available viewport height.
The sidebar scrollbar does not appear when content fits within the viewport.
No existing sidebar styles, colors, spacing, or layout are changed.
The sidebar header/title and any sticky controls remain visually anchored (do not scroll away if previously fixed).

file_operations.description: Add overflow-y-auto CSS class to the Vault sidebar container element to enable vertical scrolling when content exceeds viewport height. Ensure the sidebar maintains its existing width, background, border, and padding styles. If the sidebar has a fixed header or title section, wrap only the scrollable content area (layers, filters, controls) with the overflow-y-auto class while keeping the header outside the scrollable region to remain visually anchored.

requirements.summary: Add vertical scrolling to the NFT preview panel/page within the Vault so that all NFT preview content (image, metadata, traits) is accessible when it overflows the available height
acceptanceCriteria: The NFT preview panel scrolls vertically when its content exceeds the available height.
The scrollbar does not appear when all preview content fits within the viewport.
No existing preview panel styles, colors, spacing, typography, or layout are changed.
The overall Vault page layout (sidebar + main content + preview) remains structurally identical to Draft 169.

file_operations.description: Add overflow-y-auto CSS class to the NFT preview panel container element to enable vertical scrolling when preview content (image, metadata, traits) exceeds the available height. Preserve all existing preview panel styles including background, border, padding, typography, and spacing. Ensure the scrollable area encompasses all preview content while maintaining the structural layout of the Vault page (sidebar + main content + preview).
